content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the to-do app","i_want":"to view all saved tasks in a task list on the to-do management page","so_that":"I can see the status and priority of every task at a glance","business_description":"The to-do management page shows a task list of all saved tasks. Each row shows the task's status and priority. The list shows loading, empty and error states, and it refreshes automatically when a task is changed. The system has a single user and no sign-in, so the list shows all stored tasks.","business_value":"Users can see all their tasks in one place, with status and priority visible, and the list stays current after changes without a manual reload.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"I have two or more saved tasks","when":"I open the to-do management page","then":"the task list shows every one of the saved tasks"},{"given":"A task has the status Open and the priority High","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"that task's row shows a status indicator with the value Open and a priority indicator with the value High"},{"given":"The task list is waiting for the task data from the backend","when":"the page is displayed","then":"a loading state is shown in place of the task list until the data arrives"},{"given":"I have no saved tasks","when":"the task list loads successfully","then":"an empty state is shown and no task rows are displayed"},{"given":"The backend returns an error when the task list is requested","when":"the task list loads","then":"an error state is shown, no task rows are displayed, and the page does not show a successful state"},{"given":"The database is unavailable","when":"the backend receives a request for all tasks","then":"the backend returns an internal server error response and does not return any task data"},{"given":"A saved task with a known ID exists","when":"the backend receives a request for that task by its ID","then":"the backend returns that one task with its stored values"},{"given":"No saved task has the requested ID","when":"the backend receives a request for that task by its ID","then":"the backend returns a not-found error and does not return any task data"},{"given":"I am viewing the task list","when":"a task is created, updated, deleted or has its status changed","then":"the task list refreshes automatically and shows the change without a manual page reload"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not define paging, so the PRD does not define the format of the task ID in the request for a task by ID, so the response for a malformed ID is not specified.","When the task list is refreshing after a change and the refresh
